source_release.scope: Pinned official release, not a newest-code or current competition-server assertion.

qualified.event_rule: First sampled radius-and-polygon overlap per track token, with a separate explicit at-fault heuristic.
qualified.clock: Declared database/ego TimePoint microseconds; source-linked iteration propagation, separate from perf_counter runtime.
qualified.normal_termination: Selected local step-controller path stops at N-1, with history indices 0..N-2 for N>=2.
qualified.abnormal_termination: Synchronous exceptions and observed asynchronous metric/log failures are reported separately from outcomes.

requirements_before_any_trial: Freeze a simulator-only decision, population, endpoint, horizons, comparator and resources before acquiring records.
Verify native behavior on bounded authored positive/negative and termination controls in an isolated source fixture harness; no model or full simulator run follows automatically.
Bind exact resolved code/configuration and enabled metric/required dependency identities.
Require a complete expected-run roster, unique scenario/planner/log keys, final execution reports and metric/log callback completion.
Reconcile planned and actual timestamp vectors, monotonicity, gaps, expected N-1 history membership and finite common comparison window.
Retain any-collision events, at-fault subset, first-track de-duplication, event timestamps and history separately from aggregate score.
Preserve missing/failed/shortened/excluded outcomes explicitly; state selection/censoring assumptions, never silently label absence success.
Qualify source and artifact access terms separately; code licensing is not a grant to acquire or redistribute dataset trials.
next_action: Freeze and execute a bounded authored native-control protocol for the pinned collision/clock/termination paths before any dataset trials. Compare with ordinary direct analysis under equal information. Stop if native behavior or required receipts contradict the proposed sampled contract.
